title: The paid ledger misses eval runs made outside bin/ci
what: Every paid eval run counts in `bin/paid-cost today` and against the daily cap, including a direct `claude plugin eval` run that an agent makes while reproducing a case.
why: 25 Oct, wt/wave-red: two workers made about $22.7 of direct case runs; `bin/paid-cost today` showed $15.03, 1 run (the wave run only). The $200/day cap is blind to them, and an agent cannot see what it already spent. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: scratchpad reports/wave-red.md, "Paid case runs made on this branch": the ledger missed all direct runs.
pass_cases: After a direct eval run of one case, `bin/paid-cost today` shows its cost and the run.
where: bin/paid-cost the eval runner's aggregate-result.json, whatever records a bin/ci run in the ledger
